sections.content: Confirmed toggle behavior: clicking red target toggles the red piece between horizontal and vertical bars. So MOUSE on a right target toggles the same-color left pieces. Now I need the goal. Let me systematically test the 4 toggle combinations (red H/V × blue A/B) for level completion.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def red_state():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # red vertical if R at row24 col18; horizontal if R at row30 col13
    return 'V' if a[24][18]=='R' else 'H'
def blue_state():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # square top if a[20][18]=='b' (full); X top if a[20][18]=='b' and a[20][19]=='c'
    return 'sqTop' if a[20][19]=='b' else 'xTop'
print("start: red=",red_state(),"blue=",blue_state())
# cycle through combos, checking completion
for i in range(3):
    # toggle blue then red to reach next combo
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}])
    r1 = last_action_result.get('level_completed')
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
    r2 = last_action_result.get('level_completed')
    print(f"iter{i}: red={red_state()} blue={blue_state()} comp={r1 or r2}")
    if r1 or r2:
        print("COMPLETED!"); break
print("final: red=",red_state(),"blue=",blue_state())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
